title: A New Inclusion Compound Consisting of 2D Coordination Layers of [Cd(SCN)2]∞ and Pillars of Isonicotinamide Dimers
abstract: Abstract                Self-assembly of Cd2+, SCN−, isonicotinamide (isoNH2), and 9,10-dichloroanthracene gave a new inclusion compound formulated as [Cd(SCN)2(isoNH2)2]·1/2(9,10-dichloroanthracene) (1). This inclusion compound consists of 2D coordination layers of [Cd(SCN)2]∞ and pillars of isoNH2 dimers. 9,10-dichloroanthracene molecules are included in zigzag channels.
